description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Edits a draft in place; only the fields you pass change. Any media field replaces the draft's media as a set (keeps the id, so queue items still point at it). Refused (409) for archived or already-published items, and a media swap is refused once a queue booked it. `labels`, `opus`, `videoWatermarked`, `library` and `aiGenerated` may be changed on published items too. `aiGenerated` is the post's AI label: false for real footage, null back to automatic. A video draft's custom thumbnail/cover: `thumbnailStorageId` (an image from upload_media) or `thumbnailUrl`, or `thumbnailFrameOffsetMs` for a frame of the video; `thumbnailUrl: null` clears it. It is sent to YouTube (long-form), Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram Reels, TikTok and Pinterest at publish.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/content/{id}.)

aiGenerated.description: The post's "AI-generated" label toggle: false = real footage (no AI label), true = always label, null = automatic (on when flayr made the media). Metadata: allowed on published items. Removing the `source:ai-generated` label alone does not turn it off.

credits.description: Creator credits for work this post uses. Added to the published caption above the flayr footer, one line each: model → "Print your own: <url> (model by <author>)"; other kinds → "Credit: <title> by <author> <url>". Never added twice (a URL already in the caption is skipped); on X a shorter line (or no URL) is used, or the credits are left out, before the caption text is ever cut. YouTube: description only, never the title.

site.description: Detected from the URL when omitted (e.g. MakerWorld, Printables, Thingiverse).

url.description: Absolute http(s) link to the credited work.

imageStorageId.description: Uploaded image storageId: the video's thumbnail, or on its own the post's single image. Not with imageUrl.

imageUrl.description: http(s) image URL: the video's thumbnail, or on its own the post's single image. Not with imageStorageId.

images.description: Carousel image URLs. Cannot be combined with the other media fields.

labels.description: Replaces the labels ([] or null clears). Allowed on published items too. Normalized "key:value" labels (keys and values are lower-cased, spaces become "-"). Linked keys: campaign:<media campaign id>, experiment:<experiment id> (+ variant:<name> or the experiment's compareKey), type:<post type> (short, long-form, carousel, image, text, reel, story, poem, timelapse…). Free keys work too: cut:opus, lane:tech, parent:pantheon-part-1, ab:<pair id> (an A/B pair). Labels are copied onto every post made from the draft, and compared in GET /api/v2/analytics/experiments.

library.description: The Library item's own title and description, searchable from the Library. null or "" clears one. Metadata: allowed on published items. Not the same as `title` (the YouTube video title).

opus.description: Link this row to an Opus Clip clip (owner only; allowed on published rows) so an Opus project import skips it instead of creating a duplicate. null unlinks.

clipId.description: Opus clip id: the full "{projectId}.{curationId}" or the short curation id with projectId.

projectId.description: Opus project id. Optional when clipId is the full "{projectId}.{clipId}" id.

platformText.description: Per-platform captions: platform id → the caption that platform gets instead of `text`, e.g. { "twitter": "short version" }. Each must fit its platform: X 280 (a link counts 23, an emoji 2), Bluesky 300, Threads 500, Instagram 2200, LinkedIn 3000. Platforms without one get `text` when it fits, else an automatic short version: the first line, the credits in short form, as many hashtags as fit and the short flayr link (hashtags go first, then the credit link becomes "Model by <author>"; words are never cut). PATCH merges: a null (or "") value clears that platform, platformText: null clears all. At publish every platform is validated on its own caption: one failing platform no longer fails the others — the post publishes to the rest and reports the failures in platformErrors.

thumbnailFrameOffsetMs.description: Use this frame of the video (ms from the start) as the cover. Instagram and TikTok get the offset; YouTube/Facebook/LinkedIn need an image, so pass the captured frame as thumbnailStorageId / thumbnailUrl too.

thumbnailStorageId.description: Custom video thumbnail: an image storageId from POST /api/v2/media/upload-url. Not with thumbnailUrl. null clears.

thumbnailUrl.description: Custom video thumbnail: an http(s) image URL. Not with thumbnailStorageId. null clears.

title.description: Shorthand for youtube.title (the video title). No < or >.

videoStorageId.description: storageId from uploading to POST /api/v2/media/upload-url's uploadUrl. Not with videoUrl. Another account's upload is refused (422).

videoUrl.description: http(s) URL of the new video. Not with videoStorageId.

videoWatermarked.description: The item's own video already has the "Posted by flayr.social" watermark: publish it as-is. null clears.

at.description: When it was watermarked (epoch ms). Default: now.

youtube.description: Merged into the stored YouTube options. YouTube upload options, applied to YouTube targets only. madeForKids is always sent to YouTube (default false). A missing title is derived from the first sentence of the caption, cut to 100 characters at a word boundary. SCHEDULED UPLOADS: the video is uploaded ahead of scheduledAt. "public" is uploaded as private and released by YouTube at the scheduled time; "unlisted" is watchable by anyone with the link from upload time; "private" stays private.

categoryId.description: YouTube category id, e.g. "28" (Science & Technology). YouTube default: 22.

firstComment.description: For scheduled videos, posted at the scheduled time.

playlistId.description: From GET /api/v2/youtube/playlists for the same brand.
